requirements.quote: OpenID Providers supporting Discovery MUST make a JSON document available at the path formed by concatenating the string /.well-known/openid-configuration to the Issuer.
issuer — REQUIRED. URL using the https scheme with no query or fragment component that the OP asserts as its Issuer Identifier.
jwks_uri — REQUIRED. URL of the OP's JSON Web Key Set [JWK] document.
id_token_signing_alg_values_supported — REQUIRED. JSON array containing a list of the JWS signing algorithms (alg values) supported by the OP for the ID Token to encode the Claims in a JWT.
claims_supported — RECOMMENDED. JSON array containing a list of the Claim Names of the Claims that the OpenID Provider MAY be able to supply values for.
